valueCards.title: Roofing Expertise
valueCards.body: Replacements, repairs, and everything the details demand — flashing, valleys, penetrations, and ventilation. The parts that decide whether a roof lasts.

valueCards.title: Honest Inspections
valueCards.body: Licensed inspectors, photo documentation, and a straight answer. If your roof does not need work, that is what we will tell you.

valueCards.title: Quality Exterior Work
valueCards.body: Gutters, fencing, and outdoor improvements handled with the same standard as the roof, because it is all the same weather.

valueCards.title: North Texas Coverage
valueCards.body: Dallas–Fort Worth as our core market, with regular work across surrounding North Texas communities and roughly a two-hour radius from Dallas.

process.title: Request an inspection
process.body: Call or send the form. Tell us what you are seeing and where you are.

process.title: Property and roof evaluation
process.body: A licensed inspector assesses the roof and, where accessible, the attic — documenting condition with photographs.

process.title: Review findings and options
process.body: We show you the photos and explain what is urgent, what can wait, and what is cosmetic. In plain language.

process.title: Approve the project scope
process.body: You get a free written estimate. Nothing is ordered or scheduled until you approve the scope.

process.title: Complete the work
process.body: Property protected, materials delivered, and the work performed by our crew.

process.title: Final walkthrough and cleanup
process.body: Magnet sweep for nails, debris hauled off, and a walkthrough with you before we leave.

whyTimber.title: Integrity-first recommendations
whyTimber.body: The recommendation is whatever the roof actually needs. Sometimes that is a repair. Sometimes it is nothing at all.

whyTimber.title: Free inspections and estimates
whyTimber.body: No charge, no obligation, and you keep the photographs either way.

whyTimber.title: Fully insured
whyTimber.body: Coverage is in place before anyone sets foot on your property.

whyTimber.title: Licensed inspectors
whyTimber.body: Your roof is assessed by a licensed inspector, not by whoever was available with a ladder.

whyTimber.title: Quality roofing work

whyTimber.title: Clear communication

whyTimber.title: Respectful job sites
whyTimber.body: Landscaping protected, nails swept, debris hauled. Your property is left the way we found it.

whyTimber.title: Local and regional
whyTimber.body: Based in DFW and working across North Texas, roughly two hours out from Dallas for the right project.

stormItems.title: Hail damage
stormItems.body: Impact bruising and granule loss, frequently invisible from the ground.

stormItems.title: Wind damage
stormItems.body: Broken seals, creased shingles, and uplift along rakes and ridges.

stormItems.title: Missing or lifted shingles
stormItems.body: Exposed underlayment and shingles that no longer bond.

stormItems.title: Roof leaks
stormItems.body: Active intrusion traced to its real entry point, not the nearest stain.

stormItems.title: Fallen debris
stormItems.body: Limb impact, punctures, and damaged decking.

stormItems.title: Emergency tarping
stormItems.body: Temporary protection to stop further water damage while a repair is scheduled.

stormItems.title: Post-storm inspections
stormItems.body: Documented assessment while the evidence is fresh.

homeFaqs.q: Are your inspections and estimates really free?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Free inspections and free estimates, with no obligation. You keep the photo documentation whether or not you hire us.

homeFaqs.q: How do I know if my roof has storm damage?
homeFaqs.a: Usually you cannot tell from the ground, which is the whole problem. Dented gutters, granule wash in the driveway, and shingle debris in the yard are good hints. A free inspection settles it.

homeFaqs.q: Do I need a full replacement or will a repair work?
homeFaqs.a: It depends on how widespread the damage is and how much life the roof has left. If a repair will genuinely hold, we will tell you that — even though the replacement would be the bigger invoice.

homeFaqs.q: How far do you travel from Dallas?
homeFaqs.a: Dallas–Fort Worth is our core market, and we work throughout surrounding North Texas. We will travel roughly two hours in any direction from Dallas for the right project. Call with your address and we will give you a straight answer.

homeFaqs.q: Will you handle my insurance claim?
homeFaqs.a: No. We are not a public adjuster, attorney, or insurer. We can document visible damage, explain the roofing scope, and provide project information that you may share with your carrier. The claim itself is between you and your insurance company.

homeFaqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
homeFaqs.a: Many single-family homes are a one to two day job once materials are on site, depending on size, pitch, complexity, and weather. You will get a realistic window with your estimate.

homeFaqs.q: What happens to the mess and the nails?
homeFaqs.a: Debris goes into a container on site and leaves with us, and we run magnets across the yard, beds, and driveway. Nails in tires are the most common complaint about roofing crews and it is entirely preventable.
A licensed inspector. Where a roof is too steep or too fragile to walk safely, we document it with drone imagery instead — which gives a better record anyway.
